grading.primary: Mean of per-application closed-set F1, averaging repeats within each application. Both actual and predicted empty sets score 1; actual empty with any false prediction scores 0.
grading.exclusion_reason: The SDK environment-resource behavior was already examined in the earlier post-hoc probe. It remains a diagnostic control and is excluded from the primary score to avoid presenting a known mechanism as new holdout evidence.
grading.secondary: Micro precision/recall and per-unit mistakes. All finding IDs receive supported/contradicted/unresolved factual-premise review; recommendations are not defects solely for being optional.
grading.blinding: Two fresh grading sessions per paired report set, randomized opaque report IDs/order; version labels and skill source are withheld. Model grading, not independent human review.
grading.agreement: Only unanimous unit predictions and factual finding verdicts are accepted; disagreement is unresolved. Any unresolved unit blocks a superiority claim; unknown finding premises remain visible and conservatively count as not established supported.
grading.acceptance: Candidate macro-F1 gain at least 0.05, paired application-cluster bootstrap 95% percentile interval lower bound above 0, and factual finding support rate no more than 0.02 below baseline. No post-output skill changes or case removal.

bootstrap.cluster: application; repeat scores averaged before resampling

grading.limits: Six newly authored synthetic applications, two languages, two repetitions. Exploratory evidence for these patterns, not proof for arbitrary production applications. Cases are not used to tune either frozen skill version.
